note: Homepage atmosphere assets. Exported from Figma with download_assets at node resolution, then resampled down with Lanczos (aspect preserved). No redraw, no retrace, no recolour, no crop. HOPE/LESS/NESS and TIME/LESS/NESS are not listed here: they already live in the curated cutout library at src/assets/cutouts/ (nodes 1737:3 and 1737:4) and are reused from there. The four sky plates are not Figma exports: they are generated from the repository's own cloud photographs by scripts/build-sky-dither.mjs and are listed below with the parameters that reproduce them.

assets.alt: A damaged roadside billboard reading “There are no termites in Spokane”.

source.note: The Figma frame's own cloud fill is a 440 x 293 review copy and is not shipped. This is the repository's full-resolution photograph of the same composition, reduced to the same 440px grid the frame was drawn on.

export.palette: 12 fixed sky tones, warm cream to cool blue-grey, chosen to the frames' measured atmosphere (mean 174/186/190, saturation 0.08)
export.pipeline: resize cover (Lanczos) -> modulate saturation 0.16 brightness 1.26 -> linear 0.6/72 -> altitude and horizon gradient -> Bayer 8x8 ordered dither to the palette, spread 26
